svg.title: dice, by Sloppy Jo
svg.desc: Head-and-shoulders portrait in Sloppy Jo's hand-drawn style: wobbly dark ink outlines and grainy flat colour on cream paper, set against a steel-blue disc crossed by fine ruler-straight rain lines. dice is a woman in her early forties with olive skin and short black hair in a textured French crop with a choppy fringe. She has dark eyes, one eyebrow slightly raised, and a wry half-smile. She wears a worn brown waxed jacket with a dark collar and brass studs, open over a black crew-neck top. A small spiral notebook pokes out of her chest pocket, drawn ruler-perfect, the one digital thing about her. Caption: dice, temporal explorer, roll the dice. Signed Sloppy Jo with braille dots for c j.
